messages:
mira: Heads-up from AcmeHealth: they want a short end-of-quarter demo that ties a latency spike to a model rollout and shows per-route cost impact. Can we scope something small and shippable?

jay: Yes. Two minimal pillars: 1) billing export gains model_version + per-route cost column, 2) trace sampling that ramps on p95 or error spikes so we have traces during incidents.

tara: For traces: baseline sample 0.03, ramp to 0.5 when route p95 > 120ms OR error_rate > 1%. Tenant cap 0.25 to avoid blast radius. Also add a support "capture now" button.

ken: Runtime note: adding model_version to billing is straightforward if we surface the model tag from the router. Backfill will need a short job. Tracing ramp needs exporter caps; otherwise storage/QPS could spike.

mira: Acceptance for demo: (A) CSV export includes model_version for top 50 routes, (B) UI heatmap shows cost by route and model_version, (C) when we inject a synthetic 250ms tail in sandbox, sampling ramps and we capture >=40 traces, (D) support can toggle capture for 30m.

jay: Estimates: billing change + export UI = 6 dev-days. Sampling ramp + exporter cap = 10 dev-days. Support toggle UI = 2 dev-days.

tara: I'll prepare synthetic generator and a demo README marking data as synthetic. Also will include redaction guidance: redact prompt text by default; enterprise opt-in for full traces.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature/mini-cost-heatmap -> staging at 2025-06-21T08:12:33Z

ken: Action list:
- jay: implement billing tag & export (owner) - due 2025-06-30
- tara: adaptive sampling prototype + demo traffic (owner) - due 2025-07-06
- ken: exporter cap + canary test plan (owner) - due 2025-07-03
- mira: runbook draft (privacy, KMS checklist, rollback) - due 2025-06-28

mira: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own and :eyes: if you're just reviewing. Keep scope tight; demo fidelity matters more than full rollout.
